title: StoneEra’s first playable demo is almost ready — submitting it to Steam for review around September 25–26
author: Arrock12
selftext:
I’m finishing up the first public demo of StoneEra and planning to **submit it to Steam for review around September 25–26**.  
After that, I’ll be waiting for Steam’s approval before the demo can go live.  
The demo will offer roughly **1 hour of gameplay** and include a good portion of the core systems I’ve been building:  
• Village building and management  
• Crafting and production  
• Dynamic, flowing water  
• Water usage and water-management systems  
• Procedurally generated maps with random seeds  
• Around 200 different NPCs  
• Hunting and farming  
• Several other mechanics for developing and managing your settlement  
This will be the first public playable version of StoneEra, so I’m especially interested in feedback on the gameplay loop, balancing, controls, and anything that feels confusing or unfinished.
